description:
ClickHouseNativeHandler.load_table() currently processes one shard file per
call.  For a sharded benchmark table (e.g., lineitem.tbl.1 … lineitem.tbl.10)
the DataLoader loop issues 10 separate INSERT INTO ... SELECT * FROM file(path)
statements.

ClickHouse's table function file() (and s3() for cloud) support glob patterns:
  file('/data/lineitem*.tbl', 'CSV', 'col1 UInt64, ...')
A single INSERT using a glob covers all shards in one query-plan pass.

This TODO implements load_table_bulk() in ClickHouseNativeHandler, leveraging
the load_table_bulk() interface introduced in bulk-shard-loading-duckdb.

Scope is ClickHouse (self-hosted) and ClickHouse Cloud adapters only.
It explicitly excludes platforms backed by DelimitedFileHandler (SQLite,
PostgreSQL, DataFusion, etc.) which have no SQL multi-file primitive.

anti_patterns.dont: concatenate shard CSV files on disk
anti_patterns.instead: use the glob pattern in SQL instead
anti_patterns.why: that requires temp storage and file I/O

anti_patterns.instead: derive the common prefix programmatically from the actual file names
anti_patterns.why: shard naming conventions may differ (e.g., _N vs .N)

anti_patterns.dont: skip the fallback to per-file loop
anti_patterns.instead: the fallback ensures correctness in all cases
anti_patterns.why: shards may legitimately be in different dirs for re-loaded manifests

work_units.notes:
Algorithm:
1. Derive a glob from the shard list. All shards for a table share a common
   stem: if paths are ['lineitem.tbl.1', 'lineitem.tbl.2', ...] in the same
   directory, the glob is 'lineitem.tbl.*'.
2. Validate: all paths share the same parent dir and the same stem prefix.
   If not (edge case), fall back to the default loop via super().load_table_bulk().
3. Build SQL:
     INSERT INTO {table}
     SELECT * FROM file('{dir}/{stem}.*', 'CSV', '{col_schema}')
4. Execute and return COUNT delta (before/after) as for DuckDB.

The ClickHouse file() function requires an explicit column schema string for
CSV - derive it from DESCRIBE TABLE {table} (or equivalent).
Dry-run: capture SQL then return len(file_paths)*1000.
work_units.summary: Implement ClickHouseNativeHandler.load_table_bulk() using file() glob pattern for self-hosted ClickHouse
